description: Source code for AvroSerializer class in Apache Spark, responsible for serializing Spark SQL catalyst data types to Avro format, including schema resolution, type conversions, and handling complex types and unions.

classes.name: AvroSerializer
classes.description: A class that serializes Spark SQL catalyst data types into Avro format, handling schema resolution, type conversions, and complex data structures.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes catalyst data into Avro format using the configured converter.

methods.name: newConverter
methods.description: Creates a converter function to transform catalyst data types into Avro-compatible data based on schema.

methods.name: newStructConverter
methods.description: Creates a converter for struct types, mapping catalyst StructType to Avro Record.

methods.name: newComplexUnionConverter
methods.description: Creates a converter for complex union types, mapping to struct with member fields.

methods.name: resolveNullableType
methods.description: Resolves an Avro schema to its non-null type if it is a union with null, considering nullability.

methods.name: resolveAvroType
methods.description: Determines if an Avro schema is nullable and returns the non-null schema if applicable.

methods.name: warnNullabilityDifference
methods.description: Logs warnings if there is a mismatch in nullability between Avro schema and catalyst schema.

methods.name: nonNullUnionTypes
methods.description: Returns the set of non-null types within an Avro union schema.
